acceptance_predicates.description: The canonical pr-fast and reduced release qualification tiers enforce aggregate 300-second and 900-second verifier budgets, including download, admission, model execution, checksum, and attestation.
Receipts bind the exact candidate, model set, declared and completion-time elapsed budget, and explicit non-claims for implementation refinement and the full two-process cross-product.
Hour-scale full-exhaustive runs are scheduled or manual advisory evidence and cannot obstruct ordinary progression until AR-0102.

definition_of_done: The exact product merge and exact-main verification demonstrate the bounded tiers and their failure checks.
The tracked evidence records measured pr-fast and reduced release-tier runs below their declared budgets.
No signature, authentication service, GitHub approval, or independent reviewer is required for the transition.

inputs.description: The Coordinator formal runner, tier evidence, bounded-model configurations, and exact current-main candidate.

outputs.description: A locally reproducible, exact-candidate formal receipt with aggregate budget and truthful claim boundaries.

gates.description: Locally reproducible functional checks and truthful exact-head evidence are required.
